full_name: Benjamin Steege | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Benjamin Steege studies the history of music theory and aesthetics in the 19th and 20th centuries, with particular attention to early modernism. He is an assistant professor in the Department of Music at Columbia University.
